description: Method-neutral synthetic sphere and box drop cases for Q-RIGID/Q-CONTACT development plumbing and cross-engine comparison; not captured-site or instrumented physical evidence.

metric_definitions.contact_sequence: Whether the simulated body made ground contact during the bounded trajectory.
metric_definitions.penetration: Maximum negative MuJoCo contact distance converted to nonnegative meters.
metric_definitions.first_contact_time: Simulation step of first contact multiplied by the fixed timestep.
metric_definitions.replay: Exact digest agreement across two complete executions of each case.
